Effect: an UPWARD LAUNCH HIT on a figure (do NOT draw the figure), 5 frames: 1 a white-gold flash at the bottom middle; 2 a burst of golden light shoots up 20 squares from the bottom, 3 small white feathers swirling up with it; 3 the streak at full height, gold sparks; 4 the streak fading to orange, the feathers at the top; 5 fading sparks.
Layout: one horizontal row of 5 equal cells, each 256x416 (image 1280x416); the figure's feet at the bottom middle of every cell. Transparent background (if not possible: pure black #000000). No gaps, no borders, no labels.
REPAIR of the attached sheet: keep the same bright effect identity, but completely re-layout it into precisely equal-width rectangular cells in ONE horizontal row. Each frame centered on its OWN cell center, with generous transparent gaps between neighboring frame silhouettes. Absolutely do not let full-size rings expand into neighboring cells. Keep all sparks and the highest tip of the W column inside the cell with clear transparent padding, never clipping at the sheet edge. Remove ALL soft glow and airbrushed haze. Crisp chunky pixel blocks ONLY with transparent empty space, white/pale cores. No character silhouettes or people. Respect the stated cell width/height proportion; do not use a tall square sheet for a wide horizontal animation. Exact frame count is mandatory.
